sam: Hey @channel :wave: seeing a spike of 429s -> retries pile up and some retried requests end up missing the Idempotency-Key header. Using py-sdk 0.11.3. Repro is intermittent under concurrency. Anyone seen this?

alex: @sam can you paste a minimal repro + headers? also which http lib?

sam: quick repro below — simple loop using ThreadPoolExecutor + sync client. I set `Idempotency-Key` in headers. When hammering with 50 threads about ~3% of retried requests don't have the header on the wire.

sam: ```python
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import uuid
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED", version="0.11.3", retries=5)

def call():
    headers = {"Idempotency-Key": uuid.uuid4().hex}
    resp = client.post("/v1/generate", json={"prompt":"hi"}, headers=headers)
    print(resp.status_code, headers.get("Idempotency-Key"))

with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=50) as ex:
    for _ in range(200):
        ex.submit(call)
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out py-sdk 0.11.3 earlier today (release note: retry header cloning optimization + jitter reseed change)

maria: thanks @sam — are you using sync (requests) or async (aiohttp) client? any proxy / gunicorn config?

sam: sync (requests). no proxy. running under gunicorn with preload=false. requests 2.31.0, urllib3 1.26.17.

jordan: can you paste a sample server ingress log showing the request headers when header missing? redact tokens please.

sam: pasted a few lines from our ingress: 
INGRESS 2025-03-10T12:11:03Z req_id=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/generate headers="Host: api.redwood.com; Idempotency-Key: ; Content-Length: 348" status=200 latency=120ms
INGRESS 2025-03-10T12:11:04Z req_id=abc124 method=POST path=/v1/generate headers="Host: api.redwood.com; Idempotency-Key: 6f1a2d...; Content-Length: 352" status=429 latency=95ms

alex: looks like some requests have Idempotency-Key blank — implies header not set on the wire or cleared by retry wrapper. Are you seeing this only on retried requests?

sam: yes — non-retried requests always show the header. retried ones sometimes show blank. instrumented the client and saw header disappear only when retry triggered after a connection timeout.

maria: we recently landed a performance change in the retry wrapper in 0.11.3 to avoid copying PreparedRequest for speed. That optimization mutates the PreparedRequest.headers in place which can drop per-call headers when connection pool reuses objects. Which HTTP session config are you using?

sam: default requests.Session, adapter max_retries not set. confirmed behavior reproducible locally when I simulate connection timeout then retry.

jordan: temporary workaround: set env var `REDWOOD_RETRY_COPY_HEADERS=true` to force a defensive copy per retry. can you test? Also please open ticket S-12345 with full traces + HAR/tcpdump.

sam: tried env var — my local load test shows no header loss now. :relieved: will open S-12345 and attach logs.

maria: confirmed bug — the non-copying optimization led to header mutation/clearing on retry in sync requests path. We'll ship 0.11.5 with the copy-by-default fix and keep the fast-path opt-in behind an explicit flag. We'll also add a test for idempotency header preservation under connection reuse.

alex: FYI there's also a separate jitter reseed issue: when processes are forked (gunicorn workers) the RNG used for deterministic jitter was reseeded the same across workers causing correlated retry windows (thundering herd) on restarts. We'll include a fork-safe reseed in the same patch.

sam: nice — thanks. Do you need my traces? I can include the tcpdump and a small harness.

ops-bot: incident-bot: created ticket S-12345 and assigned to SDK team (maria).

maria: thanks — assigning to eng-requests for patch and changelog. @alex can you add this to the release notes and add migration docs for the env var?

sam: thanks everyone, will monitor staging once 0.11.5 hits and report back.

alex: great. If anyone else hits this under heavy concurrency, please ping this thread and include `REDWOOD_RETRY_COPY_HEADERS=true` test result.

sam: will do. :thumbsup:
